We had to practice project planning by developing a project of our choice that could be done within a fictional one-year timeline.  Our progression was evaluated by submitting one digital deliverable each week from the start to the end of the quarter before presenting all our information to the class during the final week.  This professional course allowed me to work with people from far different backgrounds, which gave me more insight into the real world.
